about: Color & Tone page pictures: compare stills (--pairs) and preset strips (--presets). node scripts/effect-lab.mjs --pairs scripts/effect-lab-shots/color.json --only <name>; node scripts/effect-lab.mjs --presets scripts/effect-lab-shots/color.json --only <effect id>

pairs.name: brightness
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Brightness at Amount 0.7 right: the haze, the curtains and her skin turn clearly lighter and the dress glows, while the deepest shadows on the floor stay dark and the white of the dress does not burn out
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Amount 0.7 (the Full Light preset).

pairs.name: contrast
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Contrast at Amount 1.5 right: the haze and the back wall sink into deep black, the dress and her skin stand out brighter and a little warmer, and the white of the dress keeps its folds
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Amount 1.5 (the Bold preset).

pairs.name: exposure
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Exposure at +1 EV right: twice the light, so her skin, the dress, the haze and the floor all turn brighter, the shadows open up and the brightest folds of the dress come close to white
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Exposure +1 EV, twice the light.

pairs.name: exposure-gamma
pairs.alt: The dancer split down the middle: the left half with Gamma 0.6, where the haze and her skin are heavier and darker, the right half with Gamma 1.6, where the mid-tones open into a light, softer grey while the white of the dress stays the same
pairs.caption: Left half: Gamma 0.6. Right half: Gamma 1.6.

pairs.name: levels
pairs.alt: The dancer on a dark stage, original left and with Levels at Output Black 0.12 and Output White 0.9 right: the black stage and the floor turn a soft dark grey, the dress is a little duller and nothing is pure black or pure white any more
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Output Black 0.12, Output White 0.9 (the Matte Film preset).

pairs.name: levels-input
pairs.alt: The dancer split down the middle: the left half with Input Black 0.2, where the haze and the shadows of her dress sink into black, the right half with Input White 0.7, where her skin and the dress turn much brighter and the lightest folds burn out to white
pairs.caption: Left half: Input Black 0.2. Right half: Input White 0.7.

pairs.name: saturation
pairs.alt: The harbour town on the coast, original left and with Saturation at Amount 1.8 right: the sky turns a deep blue, the sea a strong turquoise and the house fronts glow in orange, pink and yellow, while the white clouds and the white boats stay white
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Amount 1.8 (the Vivid preset).

pairs.name: vibrance
pairs.alt: The dancer leaping in front of a green screen, original left and with Vibrance at Amount 1 right: the pale green of the screen turns a strong, bright green, while her skin, her dark hair and the white dress look almost unchanged
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Amount 1 (the Vibrant preset).

pairs.name: vibrance-skin
pairs.alt: The dancer's face, shoulders and arm in front of the green screen, the same crop twice: left with Saturation 1.8, where her skin turns orange-red, right with Vibrance 1, where the green is just as strong but the skin stays natural
pairs.caption: Left: Saturation 1.8. Right: Vibrance 1.
